messages:
lucy: quick thread to lock GA checklist for Realtime API. want compact signoff items: SLA baseline, monitoring gates, runbook, support tiers, pricing pilot. assign owners?

devon: i'll take SLA + monitoring. propose gating: p95 < 350ms, error_rate < 0.5% over rolling 1h, availability >= 99.9%.

mira: ops will own runbook + rollout. need oncall coverage for first 72h and automated smoke that runs post-deploy. canary plan: 5% for 1h, 20% for 4h, then 100% if green.

chris: docs owns KB + customer-facing notes. i'll produce internal debug checklist + public FAQ. need sample failure traces from eng.

finance: pricing will propose a short pilot discount tier. need sample usage (three profiles) to size impact. billing stays per-token for GA.

lucy: agreed owners: SLA=devon, ops=mira, docs=chris, pricing=finance. acceptance criteria before GA flip: alerts in place, runbook linked, rota staffed, pricing PR, docs merged, smoke green for 12h.

devon: i'll push Prometheus rules and a small Grafana dashboard. example alert: ALERT Realtime_P95 IF histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(req_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.35 FOR 10m

mira: ops will wire that alert to paging: p95 breach -> slack alert, p99 or error spike -> page. also locking 8 GPUs for first 48h.

chris: docs ETA EOD today for PR. will include curl examples and support templates.

finance: PR draft ready by 16:00 UTC. pilot note: "50% discount for first 6 weeks, explicit upgrade path to standard tiers."

lucy: support SLAs for pilot: 24h ack, 72h workaround/rollback. enterprise per existing SLA doc. ok?

mira: ok but need night coverage for enterprise. we'll staff accordingly.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled by @mira for Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC.

lucy: final: owners post PR links in this thread by EOD. if all green, handshake meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC to flip to GA. any blockers?
devon: small model perf tweak in flight, expect validation by tonight.

finance: waiting on exact usage profiles from product to finalize numbers. pinging account owners.

lucy: thanks team 1:30 sync tomorrow to confirm. :thumbsup:
